entities.name: Meherdates of Parthia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Meherdates of Parthia was a Parthian prince who played a pivotal role in the 49-51 AD succession crisis, competing against Gotarzes II for the Parthian crown.

Born into the royal family of Vonones I, Meherdates' ascension to power was marked by brutal suppression and mutilation at the hands of his defeated rival.

The aftermath of the conflict saw Meherdates' capture and subsequent exile, leaving behind a legacy of bloodshed and instability in the region.
